content:
I don’t think we’ve ever seen an SBC based on a UNISOC mobile chip, but the Banana Pi BPI-M2C offers exactly that, with a UIS7885 octa-core Arm Cortex-A76/A55 SoC featuring an 8 TOPS NPU and 5G cellular + GNSS connectivity. The SBC also comes with 4GB LPDDR4X, 128GB eMMC flash, HDMI and MIPI DSI display interfaces, a 3.5mm audio jack, a MIPI CSI camera connector, Gigabit Ethernet, WiFi 5, Bluetooth 5.4,  four USB 2.0 ports, and a 40-pin GPIO header for expansion. Banana Pi BPI-M2C specifications: SoC – UNISOC T820 (UIS7885) Octa-core CPU – 1x Cortex-A76 core @ 2.7 GHz + 3x Cortex-A76 cores @ 2.3 GHz + 4x Cortex-A55 cores @ 2.1 GHz GPU – Arm Mali-G57, up to 850 MHz NPU – IMG AX3596, up to 988 MHz, up to 8 TOPS VDSP – VQ7 DSP, up to 1014 MHz Manufacturing process – 6 nm System Memory – [...]
